+import os
+from typing import Any
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import (
+    _register_for,
+    is_attention_backend_not_set,
+    resolving_view,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_platform
+
+_SUPPORTED_MOE_RUNNERS = ("auto", "triton", "flashinfer_trtllm_routed")
+_SINK_ATTENTION_BACKENDS = ("fa3", "fa4", "triton", "trtllm_mha")
+
+
+@_register_for("FlintForCausalLM")
+def _flint_overrides(server_args: Any, hf_config: Any) -> dict:
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if cfg.moe_runner_backend not in _SUPPORTED_MOE_RUNNERS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Flint requires --moe-runner-backend in {_SUPPORTED_MOE_RUNNERS}, "
+            f"got {cfg.moe_runner_backend}."
+        )
+    if cfg.moe_a2a_backend != "none":
+        raise ValueError("Flint does not support --moe-a2a-backend.")
+    requested = (
+        cfg.attention_backend,
+        cfg.prefill_attention_backend,
+        cfg.decode_attention_backend,
+    )
+    if any(b not in (None, *_SINK_ATTENTION_BACKENDS) for b in requested):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Flint needs attention sinks; use one of {_SINK_ATTENTION_BACKENDS}."
+        )
+    if "trtllm_mha" in requested and len(set(requested) - {None}) > 1:
+        raise ValueError("Flint cannot mix trtllm_mha with other attention backends.")
+    os.environ.setdefault("FLASHINFER_USE_CUDA_NORM", "1")
+
+    overrides = {}
+    default_backend = (
+        "trtllm_mha" if "trtllm_mha" in requested else _default_attention_backend()
+    )
+    if is_attention_backend_not_set(cfg):
+        overrides["attention_backend"] = default_backend
+    elif cfg.attention_backend is None:
+        if cfg.prefill_attention_backend is None:
+            overrides["prefill_attention_backend"] = default_backend
+        if cfg.decode_attention_backend is None:
+            overrides["decode_attention_backend"] = default_backend
+    if cfg.moe_runner_backend == "auto":
+        overrides["moe_runner_backend"] = (
+            "flashinfer_trtllm_routed" if get_platform().is_sm100 else "triton"
+        )
+    return overrides
+
+
+def _default_attention_backend() -> str:
+    if get_platform().is_sm100:
+        return "fa4"
+    if get_platform().is_sm90:
+        return "fa3"
+    return "triton"

+from typing import List, Optional, Union
+
+from transformers import PretrainedConfig
+
+SLIDING_ATTENTION = "sliding_attention"
+
+
+class FlintConfig(PretrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "flint"
+    keys_to_ignore_at_inference = ["past_key_values"]
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vocab_size: int = 150144,
+        hidden_size: int = 2048,
+        intermediate_size: int = 6144,
+        num_hidden_layers: int = 49,
+        num_attention_heads: int = 32,
+        num_key_value_heads: int = 4,
+        head_dim: int = 128,
+        hidden_act: str = "silu",
+        max_position_embeddings: int = 262144,
+        initializer_range: float = 0.02,
+        rms_norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+        use_cache: bool = True,
+        tie_word_embeddings: bool = False,
+        rope_theta: float = 10000.0,
+        rope_parameters: Optional[dict] = None,
+        attention_bias: bool = False,
+        attention_dropout: float = 0.0,
+        use_sliding_window: bool = True,
+        sliding_window: Optional[int] = 513,
+        layer_types: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+        no_rope_layer_indices: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+        softmax_type: str = "learnable",
+        decoder_sparse_step: int = 1,
+        moe_intermediate_size: int = 512,
+        shared_expert_intermediate_size: int = 1024,
+        num_experts_per_tok: int = 6,
+        num_experts: int = 256,
+        norm_topk_prob: bool = True,
+        router_score_function: str = "sigmoid",
+        output_router_logits: bool = False,
+        router_aux_loss_coef: float = 0.0,
+        mlp_only_layers: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+        pad_token_id: Optional[int] = None,
+        bos_token_id: Optional[int] = None,
+        eos_token_id: Optional[Union[int, List[int]]] = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        if layer_types is None:
+            layer_types = ["full_attention"] * num_hidden_layers
+        if len(layer_types) != num_hidden_layers:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"layer_types has {len(layer_types)} entries but "
+                f"num_hidden_layers is {num_hidden_layers}"
+            )
+        if softmax_type != "learnable":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Flint requires softmax_type='learnable', got {softmax_type!r}."
+            )
+        if router_score_function != "sigmoid":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Flint requires router_score_function='sigmoid', got {router_score_function!r}."
+            )
+        if decoder_sparse_step != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Flint requires decoder_sparse_step=1, got {decoder_sparse_step}."
+            )
+        kwargs.setdefault("architectures", ["FlintForCausalLM"])
+        super().__init__(
+            pad_token_id=pad_token_id,
+            bos_token_id=bos_token_id,
+            eos_token_id=eos_token_id,
+            tie_word_embeddings=tie_word_embeddings,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
+        self.num_hidden_layers = num_hidden_layers
+        self.num_attention_heads = num_attention_heads
+        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads
+        self.head_dim = head_dim
+        self.hidden_act = hidden_act
+        self.max_position_embeddings = max_position_embeddings
+        self.initializer_range = initializer_range
+        self.rms_norm_eps = rms_norm_eps
+        self.use_cache = use_cache
+        self.rope_parameters = dict(rope_parameters or kwargs.get("rope_scaling") or {})
+        self.rope_parameters.setdefault("rope_type", "default")
+        self.rope_parameters.setdefault("rope_theta", rope_theta)
+        self.rope_theta = self.rope_parameters["rope_theta"]
+        self.attention_bias = attention_bias
+        self.attention_dropout = attention_dropout
+        self.use_sliding_window = use_sliding_window
+        self.sliding_window = sliding_window if use_sliding_window else None
+        self.layer_types = list(layer_types)
+        self.no_rope_layer_indices = list(no_rope_layer_indices or [])
+        self.softmax_type = softmax_type
+        self.decoder_sparse_step = decoder_sparse_step
+        self.moe_intermediate_size = moe_intermediate_size
+        self.shared_expert_intermediate_size = shared_expert_intermediate_size
+        self.num_experts_per_tok = num_experts_per_tok
+        self.num_experts = num_experts
+        self.norm_topk_prob = norm_topk_prob
+        self.router_score_function = router_score_function
+        self.output_router_logits = output_router_logits
+        self.router_aux_loss_coef = router_aux_loss_coef
+        self.mlp_only_layers = list(mlp_only_layers or [])
+        self.enable_lm_head_fp32 = True
+        self.learnable_sink = True
+        self.hybrid_layer_pattern = [
+            int(layer_type == SLIDING_ATTENTION) for layer_type in self.layer_types
+        ]
+        self.is_hybrid_swa = self.sliding_window is not None and any(
+            self.hybrid_layer_pattern
+        )

+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Iterable, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.flint import SLIDING_ATTENTION, FlintConfig
+from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary import declare_attn, declare_ffn
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopK
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+from sglang.srt.layers.utils import get_layer_id
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import get_is_capture_mode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_backend_utils.breakable_cuda_graph.context import (
+    is_in_breakable_cuda_graph,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen2_moe import Qwen2MoeMLP
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen3_moe import (
+    Qwen3MoeAttention,
+    Qwen3MoeDecoderLayer,
+    Qwen3MoeForCausalLM,
+    Qwen3MoeModel,
+    Qwen3MoeSparseMoeBlock,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.utils import apply_qk_norm, enable_fused_set_kv_buffer
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import attention_backends, get_exec, get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils import add_prefix, set_weight_attrs
+
+
+class FlintMLP(Qwen2MoeMLP):
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return super().forward(hidden_states)
+
+
+class FlintAttention(Qwen3MoeAttention):
+    def __init__(self, *, skip_rope: bool, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self.skip_rope = skip_rope
+        self.use_fused_qk_norm_rope = False
+        self.use_fused_qk_norm_rope_cpu = False
+
+        attn_tp_size = get_parallel().attn_tp_size
+        attn_tp_rank = get_parallel().attn_tp_rank
+        sinks_dtype = (
+            torch.float32 if "trtllm_mha" in attention_backends() else torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        self.softmax_offset = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(self.num_heads, dtype=sinks_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        set_weight_attrs(
+            self.softmax_offset,
+            {
+                "weight_loader": lambda param, loaded_weight: param.data.copy_(
+                    loaded_weight.chunk(attn_tp_size, dim=0)[attn_tp_rank]
+                )
+            },
+        )
+
+    def apply_qk_norm_rope(self, qkv, positions, forward_batch):
+        if not self.skip_rope:
+            return super().apply_qk_norm_rope(qkv, positions, forward_batch)
+        self._used_fused_qk_norm_rope_last_call = False
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q, k = apply_qk_norm(
+            q=q,
+            k=k,
+            q_norm=self.q_norm,
+            k_norm=self.k_norm,
+            head_dim=self.head_dim,
+            alt_stream=self.alt_stream,
+        )
+        return q, k, v
+
+    def forward_core(self, intermediate_state):
+        hidden_states, forward_batch, inner_state = intermediate_state
+        if inner_state is None:
+            return hidden_states
+        q, k, v, fb = inner_state
+        save_kv_cache = (
+            self.skip_rope
+            or self._used_fused_qk_norm_rope_last_call
+            or not (
+                enable_fused_set_kv_buffer(fb) and self.compatible_with_fused_kv_buffer
+            )
+        )
+        attn_output = self.attn(
+            q, k, v, fb, save_kv_cache=save_kv_cache, sinks=self.softmax_offset
+        )
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output
+
+
+class FlintSparseMoeBlock(Qwen3MoeSparseMoeBlock):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        config: FlintConfig,
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig] = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        alt_stream: Optional[torch.cuda.Stream] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(layer_id, config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=prefix)
+        self.alt_stream = alt_stream
+        self.shared_expert = FlintMLP(
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.shared_expert_intermediate_size,
+            hidden_act=config.hidden_act,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            reduce_results=False,
+            prefix=add_prefix("shared_expert", prefix),
+        )
+
+    def _make_topk(
+        self, config: FlintConfig, layer_id: int, norm_topk_prob: bool
+    ) -> TopK:
+        self.gate.expert_bias = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.zeros(config.num_experts, dtype=torch.float32), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        return TopK(
+            top_k=config.num_experts_per_tok,
+            renormalize=config.norm_topk_prob,
+            use_grouped_topk=False,
+            scoring_func="sigmoid",
+            correction_bias=self.gate.expert_bias,
+            layer_id=layer_id,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if (
+            self.alt_stream is not None
+            and hidden_states.shape[0] > 0
+            and get_is_capture_mode()
+            and not torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+            and not (
+                get_exec().moe.enable_paged_experts and is_in_breakable_cuda_graph()
+            )
+        ):
+            return self._forward_dual_stream(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        shared_output = self.shared_expert(hidden_states)
+        return super().forward(hidden_states, forward_batch) + shared_output
+
+    def _forward_dual_stream(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch]
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        inplace = self.experts.moe_runner_config.inplace
+        if inplace:
+            shared_input = hidden_states.clone()
+        self.alt_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
+        if not inplace:
+            shared_input = hidden_states.clone()
+        shared_output = self.shared_expert(shared_input)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.alt_stream):
+            routed_output = super().forward(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        current_stream.wait_stream(self.alt_stream)
+        return routed_output + shared_output
+
+
+class FlintDecoderLayer(Qwen3MoeDecoderLayer):
+    def _make_attention(
+        self, config: FlintConfig, layer_id: int, **kwargs
+    ) -> FlintAttention:
+        is_sliding = (
+            config.layer_types[layer_id] == SLIDING_ATTENTION
+            and config.sliding_window is not None
+        )
+        return FlintAttention(
+            skip_rope=layer_id in config.no_rope_layer_indices,
+            sliding_window_size=config.sliding_window - 1 if is_sliding else -1,
+            config=config,
+            layer_id=layer_id,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+
+    def _make_mlp(
+        self,
+        config: FlintConfig,
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig],
+        prefix: str,
+        alt_stream: Optional[torch.cuda.Stream],
+    ) -> nn.Module:
+        if self.is_layer_sparse:
+            return FlintSparseMoeBlock(
+                layer_id=self.layer_id,
+                config=config,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=prefix,
+                alt_stream=alt_stream,
+            )
+        return FlintMLP(
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+            hidden_act=config.hidden_act,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            reduce_results=False,
+            prefix=prefix,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def stage_facts(config: FlintConfig, layer_id: int):
+        return (
+            declare_attn(),
+            declare_ffn(
+                sparse=layer_id not in config.mlp_only_layers,
+                next_layer_sparse=layer_id + 1 not in config.mlp_only_layers,
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class FlintModel(Qwen3MoeModel):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: FlintConfig,
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig] = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            decoder_layer_type=FlintDecoderLayer,
+        )
+
+
+class FlintForCausalLM(Qwen3MoeForCausalLM):
+    model_cls = FlintModel
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: FlintConfig,
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig] = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        _require_flashinfer_cuda_norm()
+        super().__init__(config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=prefix)
+
+    def get_attention_sliding_window_size(self) -> Optional[int]:
+        if self.config.sliding_window is None:
+            return None
+        return self.config.sliding_window - 1
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[Tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], is_mtp: bool = False
+    ):
+        param_names = {name for name, _ in self.named_parameters()}
+
+        def renamed_weights():
+            for name, tensor in weights:
+                name = name.replace(
+                    ".mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias", ".mlp.gate.expert_bias"
+                ).replace(".self_attn.sinks", ".self_attn.softmax_offset")
+                if (
+                    name.startswith("model.layers.")
+                    and name.endswith(".self_attn.softmax_offset")
+                    and name not in param_names
+                    and self._is_local_layer(name)
+                ):
+                    raise RuntimeError(f"Flint attention sink {name} has no parameter.")
+                yield name, tensor
+
+        super().load_weights(renamed_weights(), is_mtp=is_mtp)
+
+    def _is_local_layer(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        layer_id = get_layer_id(name)
+        return layer_id is None or self.start_layer <= layer_id < self.end_layer
+
+
+def _require_flashinfer_cuda_norm() -> None:
+    norm = sys.modules.get("flashinfer.norm")
+    if norm is None:
+        return
+    use_cuda_norm = getattr(norm, "_USE_CUDA_NORM", None)
+    if use_cuda_norm is None:
+        use_cuda_norm = os.environ.get("FLASHINFER_USE_CUDA_NORM", "").lower() in (
+            "1",
+            "true",
+        )
+    if not use_cuda_norm:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Flint requires FlashInfer's CUDA RMSNorm; set FLASHINFER_USE_CUDA_NORM=1."
+        )
+
+
+EntryClass = FlintForCausalLM
